# Accessibility Requirements Quality Checklist: Wayfinder self-assessment

**Purpose**: Validate that WCAG 2.2 AA requirements for the form, results, chart, link and print plan are complete, clear and measurable.

**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by /speckit-checklist. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Form and Input

- [ ] CHK001 Are the accessible name, grouping and label requirements for the fifteen statements and their five-point scale specified, rather than left to implementation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are keyboard operation requirements defined for every control (answers, clear, print, copy link, earlier-result link)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the incomplete-answers behaviour (which statements remain, focus to the first unanswered) specified for keyboard and screen reader users, including how the message is exposed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are focus-management requirements defined after results appear, after a retake, after Clear, and after the "Your earlier result is below" link is followed? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK005 Are target-size and focus-appearance expectations (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8, 2.4.11) stated for the scale points, or only implied by "meets WCAG 2.2 AA"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]

## Results, Chart and Announcements

- [ ] CHK006 Is "announced to assistive technology when they appear or change" defined precisely enough to tell a polite from an assertive announcement and what text is announced? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the text summary required to be complete and equivalent to the chart in every state, including earlier-versus-new and different-version results? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements that markers differ by more than colour (shape, pattern, label) stated for earlier and new positions, in both themes and in forced-colours mode? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK009 Are contrast requirements for chart marks, axis labels and low-band emphasis defined for light and dark themes separately (1.4.3, 1.4.11)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the message wording and exposure requirements defined for an unreadable or altered results link? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]

## Layout, Print and Fallback

- [ ] CHK011 Is the 320 px / no sideways scroll requirement extended to the chart, long band phrases and the copyable results link (1.4.10 reflow)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK012 Are text-spacing and 200% zoom expectations stated for the form and results? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Are heading-outline requirements stated for the assessment, results and earlier-result sections (levels, no skipped levels)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the reading order of the printed plan and the no-script statement list specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the "earlier result" link near the title specified for accessible name, position in tab order and what it targets? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK016 Does reduced-motion behaviour for any scroll or focus movement have a stated requirement? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the automated-check pass criteria in SC-006 clear about which states (empty, partial, results, comparison, error) are covered, and which criteria need manual review? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
